title: Busbar fault pulse
line: A transient Joule heating FEA study of a copper busbar strip through a 25 kA, 0.5 s fault.
description: A copper busbar strip (100 x 40 x 5 mm) carrying 400 A sees a 25 kA fault for 0.5 s. Resistivity rises with temperature, so the loss grows as the strip heats. The study solves current and temperature together for 1 s and returns the temperature history and its peak, against the adiabatic short-circuit estimate.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature of a copper busbar strip during a 25 kA fault, solved in RunMat
